d:
Taken from "Chapter II: How Dark It Is Before Dawn" by Anoushka Shankar.
On April 5, the acclaimed sitar player, producer and composer, shares the second instalment of a trilogy of mini-albums she began with "Chapter I: Forever, For Now" in October 2023. "How Dark it Is Before Dawn" will be released by LEITER on vinyl and via all digital platforms, and is preceded by this first single, "New Dawn", out now.
Written by Anoushka Shankar and Peter Raeburn
Produced by Peter Raeburn
Sitar: Anoushka Shankar
Piano: Peter Raeburn & John Mourounas
Vocals: Megan Wyler
